title: Cardmember Uplift on a Reinstated Finch Note — Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Benefit Card
content:
**Benefit.** For a Finch Note reinstated on returned merchandise in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the reinstatement card uplift is 1.00 when the card account charged for the unit is active and is a Store Card Elite or a World Elite Mastercard, 0.50 when it is active and is any other Marlowe & Finch card, and 0.00 otherwise.

The card account charged for the unit is the one named on the returned unit's purchase record; its card and its status are read from that account under Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards.

| Card account charged for the unit | Status | Reinstatement card uplift (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard | active | 1.00 |
| any other Marlowe & Finch card (Store Card, Store Card Plus, Mastercard, Platinum Mastercard) | active | 0.50 |
| any card | not active | 0.00 |
| no Marlowe & Finch card charged | — | 0.00 |
